programmes.d: In the season finale, it's a race against the end of the world as Praimfaya arrives, forcing our heroes to make impossible choices to ensure their survival.
In the fifth season premiere, Clarke (ELIZA TAYLOR) struggles to survive on a desolate, scorched earth, while her friends in space come across a long-awaited beacon of hope.
Octavia (series star MARIE AVGEROPOULOS) is forced to take guidance from an unlikely ally when the future of the bunker and all those inside it is jeopardized.
Walter and Olivia venture into the alternate world for the anticipated face-off with William Bell (special guest star LEONARD NIMOY) in the first of a two-part season finale.
The universes may never be the same on the Season 2 Finale!
In the Season Three premiere, a disoriented Olivia fights to find her way home, while Peter and Walter try to move on with their lives — unknowingly alongside the alternate Olivia.
Key information about the future is revealed when Walter and Nina meet at Massive Dynamic for the emotional reading of the last will and testament of William Bell.
Timing is critical as a series of anomalous events leads the Fringe Division to investigate deadly incidents with unimaginable coincidences.
Newton is forced to call to action a sleeping shapeshifter. As Walter and the rest of the team move the investigation to Massive Dynamic, Olivia goes on high alert.
The alternate universe Fringe Division investigates a shocking breach of security when a twin frees his brother (guest stars SHAWN and AARON ASHMORE) from a quarantined Amber area.
Bellamy (BOB MORLEY) leads the charge investigating a potential way home. Meanwhile, Clarke and Madi (LOLA FLANERY) deal with the new uncertain threat to their home.
Our heroes are forced to rely on the help of Shallow Valley's dangerous new inhabitants in order to save some of their own – with surprising results.
Octavia leads her people toward Shallow Valley against the advice of Clarke & Bellamy. Meanwhile Kane (HENRY IAN CUSICK) and Abby (PAIGE TURCO) adjust to a new set of challenges.
Kane's attempt to prove himself useful tests Wonkru's allegiance to Octavia. Madi faces an unexpected threat inside Wonkru, forcing Clarke to make an unlikely ally.
Clarke and Bellamy make a startling discovery about Wonkru's battle plans as Echo (TASYA TELES) risks her friendship with Raven (LINDSEY MORGAN) to complete her mission.
Clarke's determination to protect Madi puts Bellamy in an impossible situation.
The growing fractures in Wonkru threaten to explode once and for all. Meanwhile, in Shadow Valley, Murphy (RICHARD HARMON) starts a fire, unleashing catastrophic results.
Monty strives to show Wonkru an alternative to war, and to the Valley itself. Meanwhile, Abby's health continues to deteriorate, along with McCreary's patience.
As Clarke races to save Abby, she learns more about the trials and tribulations Wonkru faced in the bunker, and the impossible decisions they were forced to make in the dark year.

The Fringe Division (over here) investigates a bizarre case when 15 people all suffer retrograde amnesia from listening to their shortwave radios on the same frequency.
When a serial kidnapper "over there" strikes again, the familiar case hits home for Colonel Broyles, who sends a determined Olivia to investigate the abductions.
Peter grapples with the aftermath of recent events as Olivia desperately searches for an ally. Meanwhile, the Team discovers a critical device that communicates between universes.
When a victim has his heart extracted, it's just the beginning of a series of mysterious and reanimating events. Meanwhile, Peter comes to terms with his relationship with Olivia.
In the midseason premiere, an Observer makes contact with the Fringe Team to help rectify a mistake. Meanwhile, Walter befriends one of his musical heroes (CHRISTOPHER LLOYD).
In part one of the fifth season finale, Octavia leads her people into war. While behind enemy lines, our heroes must overcome their differences to save Wonkru from extinction.
In part two of the fifth season finale, Clarke and her friends must risk everything to fight one last battle for survival – only to glimpse an even darker threat to the last living valley on Earth.
In the sixth season premiere, a small group goes down to explore the mysterious new planet, while members of Wonkru on the Mothership face the consequences of their decisions.
The team on the ground fights to survive the threat they face on the new planet. Meanwhile Raven must join forces with an unlikely ally to save everyone on board the Mothership.
